ast.scope: Explicit gap: no syntax projection or semantic AST.

obernants.scope: U is build/environment/backend-shape to tagged outcome pairs. R applies mode selection and the selected pipeline. U minus R contains CPU-only GPU success and GPU success with mismatched sentence/token dimensions; accuracy is unrestricted.
Observed cached Cpu permits missing, invalid-Unicode or cpu first lookup and arbitrary later edits. Gpu requires feature plus initial gpu. Output alone cannot recover the environment history.

I is the ordered nonempty-token position list; gather x[I], complete predictions and scatter into n empty vectors. Empty outputs do not uniquely imply empty tokenization because completion may also be empty.

OnceLock P stores first load Result; after successful annotator lookup, all later model-path edits preserve a cached load error. This failure fiber does not include attempts blocked earlier by annotator failure.

coverage.description: Latch requested mode; acquire annotator and execute either CPU map or GPU cached load/gather/predict/check/complete/scatter.
